ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a clock-triggered flip-flop symbol; the upper input terminal on the left is labeled T, the lower input terminal on the left is labeled CP, and has a triangular clock trigger mark; the output terminal on the right is labeled Q, and at the lower right there is also an inverted output terminal with a small circle. From the left input T and the clock CP, it can be judged that this is a T flip-flop. Reasoning: The characteristic of a T flip-flop is that when T=0, it maintains the original state, that is Q^{n+1}=Q^n; when T=1, it toggles, that is Q^{n+1}=\overline{Q^n}. Combine these two cases with a Boolean expression: the term for T=1 is T\overline{Q^n}, and the term for T=0 is \overline{T}Q^n, therefore the characteristic equation is Q^{n+1}=T\overline{Q^n}+\overline{T}Q^n.
